final_assessment: The one-command blind pair is explored to sixteen decisions (eleven live rules, every one with a Mechanism entry; five scope entries; no open questions). Sal's model: both reviewed gates are [first, in-context]; the first slot accepts blind-pair, fresh or external, the INVOCATION decides what covers it (an invoked pair needs both halves), and orbit/config.yaml carries a per-gate preference for what is presented, default blind-pair (amends R-crc-4). Pair membership is a state machine computed from the trail with one new launch record. The external runner is per-user (global config, set at init), auto-launches every external half, and falls back to paste. The command commits and pushes, isolates the external half in a worktree at BASE, and ends at the readout. A walk discovers every unwalked pass at any severity, and the review emit's next names the change, never a path. Split recommended: rc17a (gate, launch record, discovery, short next: orbit-engine-gates, orbit-emit-composition, orbit-address-reviews) then rc17b (the command, runner setup); declaring both, and recording the R-crc-4 amendment, is the architect session's.

residuals.kind: a runner failure that yields a file which opens with the heading and parses yet is not a complete review (a truncated return)
residuals.method: running the three external readers over the return and reading its `**Reviewer**:` line at each runner's first use

residuals.kind: a channel through machine state outside the repository (a runner's session history, an assistant's memory)
residuals.method: listing what each runner reads beyond its working directory when it is recorded at setup

residuals.kind: a pass whose pair membership the trail cannot decide (a single invoked while a pair launch stands open)
an external return the trail cannot attribute to a single or to the open pair
residuals.method: each T0 emit is engine-composed and can carry the launch token it was packaged under; an audit cross-check of returns against their T0s finds a single-packaged return counted as a member
